name: Vittoria Assicurazioni
verdict: Controlled by the Acutis family: the group's shareholder chart shows Vittoria Assicurazioni 98.34% held by Yafa Holding, itself 80.43% held by Yafa S.p.A., which is 99.99% held by Carlo Acutis. Nothing found.
note: Main sponsor (front of shirt) of the Italian rugby national teams; renewed to 2028 (SportEconomy, 28 Oct 2025). Rating note (2026-09-30): no state stake anywhere in the chain (vittoria-yafa-ownership). Searched for a court, regulator, UN or major-NGO human-rights finding against Vittoria Assicurazioni (forced or child labour, deaths or injuries, discrimination, abuse of communities); nothing found.
